title: External Monitor Not Detected in Windows
symptoms: Second monitor is not detected or shows No Signal.
rootCause: Cable issue, driver problem, or display settings.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check cable connections (HDMI/DisplayPort).
2. Press Win + P and select Extend or Duplicate.
3. Update graphics drivers via Device Manager.
4. Try different port or cable.
content: Second monitor is not detected or shows No Signal. Check cable connections (HDMI/DisplayPort). Press Win + P and select Extend or Duplicate. Update graphics drivers via Device Manager. Try different port or cable.

title: Monitor Flickering or Screen Tearing
symptoms: Screen flickers, especially at high refresh rates.
rootCause: Refresh rate mismatch, driver issue, or hardware problem.
resolutionSteps:
1. Right-click desktop → Display settings → Advanced display → Change refresh rate.
2. Disable hardware acceleration in affected apps.
3. Update or roll back graphics driver.
content: Screen flickers, especially at high refresh rates. Right-click desktop → Display settings → Advanced display → Change refresh rate. Disable hardware acceleration in affected apps. Update or roll back graphics driver.

title: Wireless Mouse Not Working or Laggy
symptoms: Mouse cursor doesn't move smoothly or stops responding.
rootCause: Low battery, interference, or outdated driver.
resolutionSteps:
1. Replace batteries or recharge mouse.
2. Move USB receiver closer or to different USB port.
3. Update mouse driver in Device Manager.
4. Run Hardware Troubleshooter.
content: Mouse cursor doesn't move smoothly or stops responding. Replace batteries or recharge mouse. Move USB receiver closer or to different USB port. Update mouse driver in Device Manager. Run Hardware Troubleshooter.

title: Keyboard Typing Wrong Characters or Not Responding
symptoms: Keys produce wrong letters or some keys don't work.
rootCause: Keyboard layout mismatch, driver issue, or hardware fault.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check keyboard language layout in Settings.
2. Restart computer.
3. Update keyboard driver.
4. Test with on-screen keyboard.
content: Keys produce wrong letters or some keys don't work. Check keyboard language layout in Settings. Restart computer. Update keyboard driver. Test with on-screen keyboard.

title: Laptop Overheating and Shutting Down
symptoms: Laptop gets very hot and turns off unexpectedly.
rootCause: Dust buildup, high CPU usage, or thermal paste degradation.
resolutionSteps:
1. Clean dust from vents using compressed air.
2. Use on hard surface (not bed/lap).
3. Check Task Manager for high CPU usage.
4. Update BIOS and graphics drivers.
content: Laptop gets very hot and turns off unexpectedly. Clean dust from vents using compressed air. Use on hard surface (not bed/lap). Check Task Manager for high CPU usage. Update BIOS and graphics drivers.

title: Printer Prints Blank Pages
symptoms: Printer prints blank or very light pages.
rootCause: Low toner/ink, clogged nozzles, or driver issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check toner/ink levels.
2. Run printer cleaning cycle from printer menu.
3. Reinstall printer driver.
4. Print a test page from printer properties.
content: Printer prints blank or very light pages. Check toner/ink levels. Run printer cleaning cycle from printer menu. Reinstall printer driver. Print a test page from printer properties.

title: Printer Prints Very Slow
symptoms: Printing takes much longer than normal.
rootCause: High print quality setting, spooling issue, or outdated firmware.
resolutionSteps:
1. Set print quality to Draft or Normal.
2. Check if spooling is enabled in printer properties.
3. Update printer firmware from manufacturer site.
content: Printing takes much longer than normal. Set print quality to Draft or Normal. Check if spooling is enabled in printer properties. Update printer firmware from manufacturer site.

title: Mouse Pointer Disappears
symptoms: Mouse cursor is not visible on screen.
rootCause: Hidden pointer setting, driver issue, or display problem.
resolutionSteps:
1. Press Ctrl key to make cursor appear.
2. Update mouse and display drivers.
3. Disable Hide pointer while typing in Mouse settings.
content: Mouse cursor is not visible on screen. Press Ctrl key to make cursor appear. Update mouse and display drivers. Disable Hide pointer while typing in Mouse settings.

title: Dual Monitors Not Extending Desktop Properly
symptoms: Dual monitors show same content or don't extend properly.
rootCause: Display settings misconfiguration or graphics card limitation.
resolutionSteps:
1. Ensure both monitors are set to same scale in Display settings.
2. Align monitors in Display arrangement.
3. Check graphics card supports dual monitors.
content: Dual monitors show same content or don't extend properly. Ensure both monitors are set to same scale in Display settings. Align monitors in Display arrangement. Check graphics card supports dual monitors.

title: USB Devices Not Recognized
symptoms: USB device is not recognized by computer.
rootCause: Bad USB port, outdated driver, or device issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Try different USB port.
2. Restart PC.
3. Update USB drivers in Device Manager.
4. Run Hardware Troubleshooter.
content: USB device is not recognized by computer. Try different USB port. Restart PC. Update USB drivers in Device Manager. Run Hardware Troubleshooter.

title: Slow Internet on Specific Computer Only
symptoms: Internet speed is slow on one computer but fast on others.
rootCause: Malware, driver issue, or network adapter problem.
resolutionSteps:
1. Run Network Troubleshooter.
2. Disable IPv6 in adapter properties.
3. Check for malware using Windows Security scan.
content: Internet speed is slow on one computer but fast on others. Run Network Troubleshooter. Disable IPv6 in adapter properties. Check for malware using Windows Security scan.

title: Microsoft 365 Apps Not Responding
symptoms: Office apps freeze or stop responding.
rootCause: Add-in conflict, corrupted installation, or memory issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Repair Office installation via Settings > Apps.
2. Disable add-ins in each app.
3. Update Windows and Office.
content: Office apps freeze or stop responding. Repair Office installation via Settings > Apps. Disable add-ins in each app. Update Windows and Office.

title: Laptop Battery Draining Fast
symptoms: Laptop battery drains quickly even when idle.
rootCause: High power consumption, old battery, or background processes.
resolutionSteps:
1. Adjust power plan to Balanced.
2. Reduce screen brightness.
3. Check battery health in Settings > System > Power & battery.
content: Laptop battery drains quickly even when idle. Adjust power plan to Balanced. Reduce screen brightness. Check battery health in Settings > System > Power & battery.

title: External Hard Drive Not Showing Up
symptoms: External hard drive is not visible in File Explorer.
rootCause: Missing drive letter, driver issue, or hardware failure.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check Disk Management.
2. Assign drive letter if missing.
3. Run chkdsk on the drive.
content: External hard drive is not visible in File Explorer. Check Disk Management. Assign drive letter if missing. Run chkdsk on the drive.

title: Webcam Not Working in Teams or Zoom
symptoms: Webcam doesn't work in video conferencing apps.
rootCause: Privacy settings blocked, driver issue, or hardware problem.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check privacy settings (Camera access).
2. Update webcam driver.
3. Test in Camera app.
content: Webcam doesn't work in video conferencing apps. Check privacy settings (Camera access). Update webcam driver. Test in Camera app.

title: Monitor Shows Wrong Resolution
symptoms: Monitor displays at incorrect resolution.
rootCause: Driver issue or display settings misconfiguration.
resolutionSteps:
1. Go to Display settings and select recommended resolution.
2. Update graphics driver.
content: Monitor displays at incorrect resolution. Go to Display settings and select recommended resolution. Update graphics driver.

title: Keyboard Shortcuts Not Working
symptoms: Keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+C don't work.
rootCause: Sticky Keys enabled, driver issue, or app conflict.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check if Sticky Keys is enabled.
2. Restart File Explorer.
3. Update keyboard driver.
content: Keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+C don't work. Check if Sticky Keys is enabled. Restart File Explorer. Update keyboard driver.

title: Printer Paper Jam Error
symptoms: Printer shows paper jam error but no jam exists.
rootCause: Faulty sensor, debris, or firmware issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Power cycle printer.
2. Clean paper sensors with soft cloth.
3. Update printer firmware.
content: Printer shows paper jam error but no jam exists. Power cycle printer. Clean paper sensors with soft cloth. Update printer firmware.

title: Mouse Double-Clicking by Itself
symptoms: Mouse clicks twice for every single click.
rootCause: Worn switch, driver issue, or sensitivity setting.
resolutionSteps:
1. Adjust double-click speed in Mouse settings.
2. Replace mouse if hardware fault.
content: Mouse clicks twice for every single click. Adjust double-click speed in Mouse settings. Replace mouse if hardware fault.

title: Laptop Screen Goes Black Randomly
symptoms: Laptop screen goes black unexpectedly.
rootCause: Power settings, driver issue, or hardware failure.
resolutionSteps:
1. Check power settings (sleep timeout).
2. Update graphics and chipset drivers.
3. Run Memory Diagnostic Tool.
content: Laptop screen goes black unexpectedly. Check power settings (sleep timeout). Update graphics and chipset drivers. Run Memory Diagnostic Tool.

title: Bluetooth Devices Not Pairing
symptoms: Bluetooth device won't pair with computer.
rootCause: Bluetooth disabled, driver issue, or device compatibility.
resolutionSteps:
1. Turn Bluetooth off/on.
2. Remove device and re-pair.
3. Update Bluetooth driver.
content: Bluetooth device won't pair with computer. Turn Bluetooth off/on. Remove device and re-pair. Update Bluetooth driver.

title: SharePoint Sync Client Not Working
symptoms: SharePoint files not syncing to computer.
rootCause: OneDrive sync issue or authentication problem.
resolutionSteps:
1. Reset OneDrive (which powers SharePoint sync).
2. Re-sign in to SharePoint sync client.
content: SharePoint files not syncing to computer. Reset OneDrive (which powers SharePoint sync). Re-sign in to SharePoint sync client.

title: High CPU Usage by Antimalware Service
symptoms: Windows Defender uses excessive CPU.
rootCause: Full system scan or malware detection.
resolutionSteps:
1. Exclude folders in Windows Security settings.
2. Update Windows.
content: Windows Defender uses excessive CPU. Exclude folders in Windows Security settings. Update Windows.

title: Monitor HDMI No Signal After Sleep
symptoms: Monitor shows no signal after computer sleeps.
rootCause: Power settings or driver issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Disable Turn off display in power settings.
2. Update graphics driver.
content: Monitor shows no signal after computer sleeps. Disable Turn off display in power settings. Update graphics driver.

title: Wireless Keyboard Lag or Delay
symptoms: Wireless keyboard has noticeable typing delay.
rootCause: Low battery, interference, or driver issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Replace batteries.
2. Reduce distance to receiver.
3. Update driver.
content: Wireless keyboard has noticeable typing delay. Replace batteries. Reduce distance to receiver. Update driver.

title: Printer Offline After Sleep Mode
symptoms: Printer goes offline after computer sleeps.
rootCause: Power settings or spooler issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Restart Print Spooler service.
2. Set printer to not turn off automatically.
content: Printer goes offline after computer sleeps. Restart Print Spooler service. Set printer to not turn off automatically.

title: Touchpad Not Working on Laptop
symptoms: Laptop touchpad is not responding.
rootCause: Touchpad disabled or driver issue.
resolutionSteps:
1. Press Fn + F-key (touchpad toggle).
2. Enable touchpad in Device Manager.
content: Laptop touchpad is not responding. Press Fn + F-key (touchpad toggle). Enable touchpad in Device Manager.

title: Multiple Monitors Color Inconsistency
symptoms: Colors look different on each monitor.
rootCause: Different monitor models or color calibration needed.
resolutionSteps:
1. Calibrate colors using Display Color Calibration tool.
2. Use same monitor model if possible.
content: Colors look different on each monitor. Calibrate colors using Display Color Calibration tool. Use same monitor model if possible.

title: Mouse Scroll Wheel Not Working
symptoms: Mouse scroll wheel doesn't scroll pages.
rootCause: Dust buildup, driver issue, or hardware failure.
resolutionSteps:
1. Clean scroll wheel.
2. Update mouse driver.
3. Test in different application.
content: Mouse scroll wheel doesn't scroll pages. Clean scroll wheel. Update mouse driver. Test in different application.

title: General Hardware Device Manager Errors
symptoms: Yellow exclamation mark on devices in Device Manager.
rootCause: Missing or outdated driver.
resolutionSteps:
1. Right-click device → Update driver.
2. Restart computer.
3. Run System File Checker: sfc /scannow.
content: Yellow exclamation mark on devices in Device Manager. Right-click device → Update driver. Restart computer. Run System File Checker: sfc /scannow.
